title: Informatics Program, Doctoral Program (October 2027 Admission)
institution: SOKENDAI (The Graduate University for Advanced Studies), Informatics Program
about: SOKENDAI's Informatics Program is accepting second-round applications for its doctoral program starting October 2027. Applicants residing abroad apply November 19 to December 2, 2026 (5:00 pm JST) and must first secure a prospective supervisor.
requirements: Applicants residing abroad use the special admissions route (second round November 19 to December 2, 2026, 5:00 pm JST)
General admission (December 3 to 9, 2026) is only for applicants residing in Japan
Before applying, contact the prospective supervisor and confirm they will accept you if you pass
Entrance fee JPY 282,000; tuition JPY 267,900 per six months (2027 guideline)
